claude.performance_metric: contemporaneous antitrust divestiture to Imperial Sub ~$7.1bn at close; no later divestiture of retained Newport franchise documented
claude.rationale: Section 2 documents that T4 (Newport product franchise) transferred to RAI together with its manufacturing/distribution operations (T5) and workforce (T6), while the divested subset's product, process, and personnel all moved together to Imperial Sub — product and process moved coherently, so gap_45=0, and process moved with its organization, so gap_56=0. Section 4 states no P4 product-process disruption is documented and no P5 process-organization fracture is documented in sourced filings, so both p4_pathway and p5_pathway=0. T1/T2 channels also show no documented incoherence or model incompatibility (both same-core-model U.S. tobacco manufacturers). Since no structural gap was coded in B, gap_mitigated is NA.

gemini.performance_metric: contemporaneous divestiture of ~$7.1 billion at close; no later divestiture of retained franchise documented
gemini.rationale: The dossier states that 'the retained product franchise and its operations transferred together, while the divested subset's product and process moved together to Imperial Sub,' resulting in no structural product-process gap (gap_45 = 0). Furthermore, no process-organization mismatch is documented at the tier-transfer level (gap_56 = 0). Accordingly, there is no documented product-process disruption (p4_pathway = 0) or process-organization fracture (p5_pathway = 0) at the 3-5 year horizon.

grok.performance_metric: no later divestiture; retained Newport franchise
grok.rationale: Section 2 states T4 Newport franchise and T5 operations transferred together to RAI (net of the Imperial carve-out subset that also moved intact); section 4 explicitly codes P4 and P5 as none documented. Section 5 notes the divestiture was absorbed by asset purchase/transfer/IP license agreements at closing, confirming no unmitigated structural gap at T4-T5 or T5-T6. T1 is coded replace per the explicit exit of Lorillard board control and installation of RAI imprint.
